financings_after_balance_sheet.what: April 2023 Lincoln Park equity line share sales (105,000 shares)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In April 2023, the Company completed multiple issuances under the terms of the February 3, 2023 purchase agreement with Lincoln Park for a total of 105,000 shares sold to Lincoln Park for proceeds of $0.3 million.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Public offering closed June 6, 2023 (common shares, preferred shares, Class C and D warrants)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds to the Company, after deducting the underwriting discount and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by the Company, were approximately $5.6 million.
